title.zh: Brazil’s Halloween eve crypto deadline brings more tricks than treats
title.en: Brazil’s Halloween eve crypto deadline brings more tricks than treats

current_state.zh: Brazilian crypto exchanges face a Friday deadline to apply for authorization with the Banco Central do Brasil, with steep capital, compliance and audit requirements and open regulatory questions complicating the path to licensed operation under the country's November 2025 virtual-asset framework.
current_state.en: Brazilian crypto exchanges face a Friday deadline to apply for authorization with the Banco Central do Brasil, with steep capital, compliance and audit requirements and open regulatory questions complicating the path to licensed operation under the country's November 2025 virtual-asset framework.
